title: Structural Balance in Real-World Social Networks: Incorporating Direction and Transitivity in Measuring Partial Balance
reasoning: The study explicitly incorporates morality as a core dimension of its network analysis. It utilizes Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) to extract and categorize social ties based on moral values, specifically evaluating relationships through the lens of virtues and vices such as fairness/cheating, care/harm, and loyalty/betrayal.
